Title: Python Math
Description: Python has a built-in math module for mathematical tasks.

Challenges.Title: Min and Max
Challenges.Exercise: Find the lowest value of 5, 10, 25 using `min()` and print it.

Challenges.Title: Absolute
Challenges.Exercise: Find the absolute value of -7.25 using `abs()`.

Challenges.Title: Power
Challenges.Exercise: Return the value of 4 to the power of 3 using `pow()`.

Challenges.Title: Math Module
Challenges.Exercise: Import math and find the square root of 64 using `math.sqrt()`.
